tasks.title: Lock the data facts
tasks.why: Provenance of the elevation layer, acquisition dates, co-registration and class support. The physical argument in the introduction is unsupported until the dates exist in the paper.

tasks.title: Rerun all variants under one protocol
tasks.why: Equal epochs, one checkpoint criterion, three seeds. The current margins sit in the fourth decimal and cannot be defended from a single seed.

tasks.title: Data-efficiency ablation
tasks.why: Turns the unequal data volume from a flaw into the strongest claim available: the adaptive operator leads by more when data is scarce.

tasks.title: External baselines
tasks.why: Single-modality, early fusion, late fusion and a classical non-learning method. Without these there is no claim of state of the art, only an internal comparison.

tasks.title: Loss ablation
tasks.why: Four loss components are claimed as contributions and none is ablated.

tasks.title: Parameters and inference cost
tasks.why: Three FILL entries in the complexity table, plus the seconds per square kilometre that the national-monitoring motivation implies.

tasks.title: Ordinal metrics and confusion matrix
tasks.why: Height error in metres is the number that makes the results legible next to the canopy-height literature and defuses the objection to a macro F1 of 0.43.

tasks.title: Report the instance match rate
tasks.why: Matched-instance geometry improves trivially for a model that detects fewer and easier instances. The match rate is already computed as connectivity correctness; it only has to be reported next to every distance metric.

tasks.title: Modality ablation at inference
tasks.why: Proves the mechanism directly and costs no training. The predicted cross-over between class 1a and class 6 is the result to look for.

tasks.title: Fast-weight probe
tasks.why: The signature figure. Fast-weight movement against canopy signal to noise, contrasted with the frozen baseline.

tasks.title: Synthetic phenology stress
tasks.why: Measures the leaf-off to leaf-on mismatch that motivates the whole architecture instead of asserting it.

tasks.title: Achievable ceiling
tasks.why: A general tool other groups will borrow, and the permanent answer to reviewers who object to absolute scores.

tasks.title: Threshold-free length estimator
tasks.why: Length straight from the proximity field, with no threshold and no skeletonisation.

tasks.title: True network length
tasks.why: The first defensible estimate of how much hedgerow actually exists in this landscape, and what share the reference product sees.

tasks.title: Landscape connectivity retention
tasks.why: Connects segmentation quality to ecological function.

tasks.title: Carbon bias of a binary map
tasks.why: The sentence that earns citations outside computer vision. Needs sourced biomass coefficients first.

tasks.title: Feature-level benchmark release
tasks.why: Publishable under the Airbus licence and, as far as we can tell, without precedent in this field.

budget.note: The minimal programme drops the middle data fraction, keeps two fractions, four baselines and four loss ablations. It still supports every claim the paper makes.
